MarketingCampaignCreateRequest.description: Create an aggregate with its mandatory first source. Campaign target supports delivery_message, section_root or deeplink only; url/web_app belong to button_target. Code words are 4..100 characters, contain no whitespace and cannot be bot commands.

BroadcastCreateRequest.description: Create a draft shell. title trims to 1..120 characters; saved_segment_seq_num is nullable positive int4. schedule carries tenant wall-clock at_local; deep schedule validity and delivery preconditions are enforced by the write core. This operation does not send.

BroadcastUpdateRequest.description: Partial patch by positive tenant seq_num. Omitted fields remain unchanged. schedule:null disarms to draft; segment_filter:null resets to the whole base. Schedule validity is enforced by the write core. This operation does not send.

BroadcastLaunchExecuteRequest.description: Confirm the reviewed preparation with its exact lowercase 64-hex revision. The facade revalidates tenant, draft/scheduled state, delivery and revision, then queues; the worker alone sends/spends.

post.summary: Write a pack of content cards into Settings topics
post.description: Each item uses the canonical unified write validator. The targetTopic selects its config; CREATE forbids replaceTarget, REPLACE/RESTORE require its tenant seqId, and delivery replacement is limited to catalog/marketing. Catalog config delivery.message_content_seq_num is a strict numeric positive-int4 address resolved within the tenant; the raw message_content_id key is refused. RESTORE excludes message_chains. Content requires text, finalized media descriptors or a source page URL. The plan sets the batch cap; per-item failures remain in results, without failing successful siblings. waitResult changes waiting, not durable item identity. Poll unresolved cards by their opaque draftHandle. Authentication accepts X-Api-Key OR Bearer tgf_* credential secrets; surface-session JWTs are refused.
